detail: Unbacked wrapped-token mint: this wrapped / bridge token's mint has NO bridge-role gate, so anyone can mint the wrapped asset without any corresponding lock or burn on the origin chain - instant unbacked supply.

Flash-loan governance takeover: voting weight is read from the CURRENT token balance (balanceOf / current getVotes) at vote time, with no past-block snapshot. An attacker can flash-borrow the governance token, vote with borrowed weight, and return it in the same transaction - voting power that costs nothing to hold.
